summary:
Project Summary: Space Mission Architect

Space Mission Architect is an interactive, browser-based systems engineering game and simulator designed for solo players or collaborative teams of up to four participants. Players take on four specialized mission roles—Science Lead, Bus & Power Engineer, Launch & Orbit Specialist, and Communications & Operations Lead—to design, balance, and fly spacecraft to the Moon, Mars, or Jupiter’s icy moon Europa.

The project directly addresses the challenge of making abstract aerospace trade-offs tangible by coupling every hardware choice to a real-time resource engine and a live 2D spacecraft blueprint. Selecting high-value scientific instruments immediately impacts spacecraft mass, solar vs. nuclear power margins, radiation shielding requirements, rocket payload limits, and data downlink bottlenecks. Once pre-launch constraints are satisfied, teams test their design in a four-phase flight simulation featuring mid-mission anomaly decisions and an interactive orbital piloting mini-game.

By transforming isolated theoretical formulas into a hands-on, end-to-end mission lifecycle, Space Mission Architect empowers students and aspiring engineers to build systems-thinking skills, experience interdisciplinary teamwork, and understand how competing engineering constraints shape real-world space exploration.
